content: Omegan-Jesúsʼga-ibmar-imaksamalad

A-ibagan-sorbali, Jesús bela neggwebur-dummagan-onodii, degi, neggwebur-burwigana-onodii gualid. Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-gayaburba-nuedgi sunmakdii gualid. E-sapingan-e-ambe-gakabogwad (12) eba gudigusmarmogad.
Degi, abala omegan niaburba-isgana-nika-gusmalad nugusmalad, gwen-gwen-gegudiid nugusmalad. A-omegan, wemalad: María, Magdalenaʼye ese gordamalad. We-omegine sogagugle (7) niaburba onolesad.

Degine, Chuza-e-ome-Juana. We-Chuzaʼde Rey-Herodesʼga neg-daked-dummadid. Deginbali, Susana, degi, omegan-baigan-bukidar Jesúsʼba gudigusmarmogad. A-omegan, na ibmar-nikamaladba Jesúsʼga ibmar-imakdii gusmalad.
Jesús, ibmar-gwag-diglegedgi burbar sunmaksad
Dulemar-bukidar neggwebur-baid-baidginmalad Jesúsʼse ambikunonimalad. Amarga, Jesús burbar sunmakded, sogded:

“Ibagwengine, dule-wargwen-ibmar-gwag-digedi ibmar-gwag dignaded. Ibmar-gwag-dignaigusgu, abala ibmar-gwag igargi babatisad. Igargi-babatismaladgi dulemar annasmalad. Geb degi, a-sorbali, sikwimar-gukudimalad a-ibmar-gwag manonimalad.
”Abala, ibmar-gwag, akwamar-birgi babatisad. Dunguargu, dinguded, ar ade, akwamar-birgi neg nisarsulid, dinnagwad.
”Abala, ibmar-gwag, iko-abargi babatisad. Ibmar-gwag dunguargu, ikomar eba dungudmogad. Ikomar ibmar-gwag-ichosad. Degisoggu, ibmar-gwag gwen sanmaksasulid.

”Ar ibmar-gwag napa-nuedgi-babatismaladdi, dungudgu, nue-sanmaksad, bela-bela san-nikusad.” Ar weyob Jesús dulemarga sunmaksigu, binnasur sogded: “An-bemarga-ibmar-soged bemar mag nue-itobiele, nue-itomar.”
Geb degi, e-sapingan Jesúsʼse egichialid: —Ibmar burbar be anmarga sogsadi, ¿wede be, ibu obarsunna?
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Ar bemargardi, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaid-igar-burbar-mamaid osanalegoye maid. Dulemar-baigangardi, ega burbar soglegoed:

content.text: ‘Adi, dulemar ise-dakar imakmar-inigwele, mer mag dakmalaga,

content: Isaías 6:9
”Ar emi burbar an bemarga sogsadi, weyobdo: Ibmar-gwag, Bab-Dummad-gayaburbad.

”Ibmar-gwag-igargi-babatismaladi, we Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-sunmaked-e-wilubganad. Nia-saila sorba nonigu, dulemar-gwagegi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-nagusad ei osulononikid, adi, mer Bab-Dummadba damalaga, mer isguedgi abonolemalagar.

”Ar akwagi-babatismaladdi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba itosmargu, nue-weligwar abingasmalad. Ar wemar unnila asginbi Bab-abingasmarsoggu, ibmar-gwag-digaled-maligan-askinnegwadyobdo. Degisoggu, ichee wis Bab-Dummadba nanasmalad, ibagan-bulegan ega nonigu, Bab-Dummadgi bangudmalad.

”Ar iko-imbaba-babatismaladdi, we-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba abingasmalando. Ar undargusgu, we-napneggi-ibmar-nanaidse, degi, manise, degi, we-napneggi-unnila-yeer-itodiguedse, binsaed-galedmalad. Amar ibmar-gwag-gwen-sanmaksasulidyob gunonikid.

”Ar napa-nuedgi-babatismaladdi, wemardi, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-itosad nue abingasmalad. Gwage-nuedgi, gwage-napiragwadgi, gwen-galakussuli Bab-Dummad-gayaburbaba nanasmalad. Degisoggu, amar ibmar-gwag-nue-sanmaksamaladyob gunonikid.”
Jesús sogsagusad, ibmar-dukualed sanar-onolegedseye

Jesús sogdebar: “Dule gwallu ogasale, gwen ulu-yaba sisulid, degi, e-gabed-urba siega amba gwen imakdisurbalid. Dule gwallu ogasale, niba gwallu-siedgi osidaed, adi, dulemar dognonikir, gwallu-meegwad mag dakegar.
Debayobi ibmar bipisaale dukusulid. Be-ibmar-saed bela wisgulegedsegad. Amba be dukuar ibmar-saoen-inigwele, bela dulemar wisguedsegad, bela negache noedsegad.
”Degisoggu, nue be binsaergebed. Ar dule-ibmar-nikadga bur bule ega gatik ibmar uklegoed, ar degine, dule-ibmar-satele, amba ibmar-nikuo-itogedi e-annik sulegoed.”
Jesús-e-nan, degi, Jesús-e-urbamar
Jesús dulemar-odurdaksigu, geb degi, e-nan, degine, Jesús-urbamar, Jesúsʼse nonimalad. Ar dulemar bukidarsoggu, geg Jesúsʼse warmak guarmalad.
Jesús-owisosmarsunnad, ega sognonimalad: —Be-nan, degi, be-urbamar magaba gwismalad, be-dakbimalad.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule-Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-itomalad, degi, ebadamalad, a an-nanad, degine, amar an-urbamalad.
Jesús, burwa, demar obogilesad
Ibagwengi, Jesús na e-sapinganmala urgi nakwisgu, amarga sogded: —Mata-dummad-obakar namargwelo. Geb degi, nadmarsunnad.
Urgi nadapmargu, Jesús gabided. Geb degi, egi mataba burwa-dummad noalid. Ur, dii-ena nagusad. Degidbali, ur doged gualid.

Geb degi, e-sapingan Jesúsʼse nonimargu, Jesús-odaksamalad, ega sogdemalad: —¡Odurdaked-saila, anmar-ur dogmai, anmar bela! Jesús ataksagu, burwaga, degi, demarga binnasur sogded: “Be bogidik sae.” Geb degi, burwa boo naded, neg swilidik sigisad.

Jesús e-sapinganga sogded: —¿Ar ibiga be Bab-Dummad-bengusmala? E-sapingan dobe itodmalad, degine, geger dakdemarbalid. Na muchub-muchub sogdemalad: “¿Wede, doa-dulesunna? Burwa, degi, demarse-bakar, eba ibsaed.”
Jesús, Gadara-yargi dule-niaburba-ichesur-nikad nudaksad
Geb degi, Jesús na e-sapinganmala Gadara-dulemar-bukwadse modapmalad. A-negde, Galilea-mata-obakar naid.
Jesús urgi-aidesgu, dule-wargwen dule-nia-dikasurgus-nikad, Gadara-neggweburgined, ese nonikid. A-dule mor-yoisur gudidaed, degine, neggi gabsurbalid, neg-uan-yaba gabdidaed.
We-dule Jesús-dakargu, binnasur gormakded. Jesús-asabin yokorgi sindigar sigisad, sogded: —Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-Machi, ¿ibiga be anse achadaniki? ¡Melle be mesagwar an-imako!

Ar Jesús niaburbaga sogsad, “dulegi-maid be noe.” Dakargu, dikasurgusa dulegi niaburba maid. Ar esgoro-dubgi a-dule-mali, degi, e-argan edindamar-inigwele, degite, iidi esgoro-imakdaed. Degine, nega-dulesulidganba, nia, dule-sesdaed.
Jesús, a-dulese egichiarsun: —¿Igi be nuga? Dule, abin-sogded: —Ichesulidye an nuga. Ar ade, niamar-bukidar egi maid.
Niamar Jesúsʼgi wilenai gusad, melle niamar-wilegoed-galuse e-barmidye.
Deun, sinmar-bukidar yargi mas mananai gusad. Niamar Jesúsʼgi wilenai gusad, sinmargi e-odoye. Jesús amarga sogded, nabirye, ase be dognamarye.
Niamar, dulegi ainidgu, sinmarse ubodapid. Sinmar yar-weregedgi babatidgu, matase babatidapid. Agi bela gundoledapmalad.
Ar sinmar-edarbemalad sin-gundilesad-daksamargu, duurmakdemalad, neg-igarba-bukmaladga, degine, neggweburgi, sinmar-gusad sogdapmalad.
Degi, dulemar neggusad-dakega ainiarmalad. Jesúsʼse nonimargu, daknonimalad, dule-nia-nika-gudigusadi Jesús-naba nue mor-yoi sii, nue-nugus sii. Dulemar deyob dakarmargu, dobee itodmalad.
Ar dulemar-dule-nugusad-daksamaladi, dulemar-nonimaladga sogdemalad, dule-nia-nika-gudigusadi igi nugusa.
Geb degi, bela dulemar Gadara-yar-dikarbarmalad, bela dobee itodmargu, Jesús e-yargi-noega, egi wilenaigusmalad. Degi, Jesús urgi-nakwisgu, gannar nadsunnad.
Dule-nia-nika-gusadi, Jesús-e-sedega, Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad. Ar Jesús egi bangusokargua, ega sogded:
“Be-negse be nae, be sogna, ibibayobi Bab-Dummad nue-wile be-daksa.” Dule nadgua, bela neggweburgi sunmakdii gualid, igi Jesús ega ibmar-dummagan imaksa.
Jairo-bunolo durgusad, degi, ome Jesús-morduku-ebusgu, nugusad
Jesús gannar Capernaúm-neggweburse nonigu, dulemar-bukidaradi weligwar Jesús-abingasmalad, ar ade, bela Jesús-edarbedimalad.
Geb degi, machered-wargwen, Jairoʼye-nugadi Jesúsʼse nonikid. Jesús-mali-naba sindigar yokorgi signonikid. E-negse naega, Jesúsʼgi wilenaigusad. Jairoʼde, Judíoʼmar-onmakedneggi dule-dummadga gudiid.
Dakargu, Jairo unnila bunolo-wargwenna nikad, birgambe-gakabo nikad (12). A-bunolode, burgwedani maid. Jesús, Jairo-negse nadapgu, dulemar-bukidara, ali-ali Jesúsʼgi yolenanai gualid.
Dulemar-bukidarad-abargi ome-gwensak birgambe-gakabogus (12) boni-nalur-nika-gudiidi, gudimogad. A-ome, bela mani-nikadi inadurgangi ollomaksad, ar degite, gwen nudaklessulid.
A-ome, Jesús-yarganba nonikid, ei-morduku ebunonikid. Ome, Jesús-morduku ebusgu, boni-nalur-nika-gudiid yog-galegar naded, yog-nuguar gusad.

Geb degi, Jesús sogded: —¿Wede doa an-ebusa? Bela sulidbiye ega sogmalad. Pedro, degi, e-walik-bukmalad, Jesúsʼga sogdemalad: —Odurdaked-saila, dulemar-bukidar ali-ali be-barmesnana-naded, degite, be sogde: ‘Wede, ¿doa an-ebusye?’
Ar Jesús, abin-imakdegu, sogded: —Dule-an-ebusad mag an itoged. Ar angi an-gangued node an itosad.

Degi, ome dakdegu, ibmar-gusadi gwen dukuar gussuli, ise-wawanmakar Jesúsʼse nonikid, e-mali-naba yokorgi sindigar signonikid. Bela-dulemar-bukwad-abargi sognonikid, ede, ibiga Jesús-morduku ebusye, degine, ede, Jesús-morduku-ebusgu, yog-nuguar nadye sognonikid.
Jesús omega sogded: —Omegwa, be nue an-bengussursoggu, be nugussun. Gwage-bogidikidgi be-negse be nasun.
Amba Jesús omega sunmakgwichi, dule-wargwen, Jairo-neggi-danikid, Jairoʼga sognonikid: —Be-bunolo bato burgwisye, mer bar odurdaked-sailagi bega be-bunolo-nudakega bar wileye.
Jesús deyob dule-soge itosgu, Jairoʼga sogded: —Melle be dobgu. Unnila melle be bengu, be-bunolo nuguoed.
Jesús, Jairo-negse dogdapgu, dulemar eba gwen doged imaksasulid, unnila, Pedro, Jacobo, Juan, degi, bunolo-e-bab, degine, bunolo-e-nan, amarbi eba dogsamalad.
Jesús modapgu, dakdapid bela bobukmala, degi, binnasur ise-wilegar bunologa bonanai. Jesús amarga sogded: —Mer bomar, bunolo burgwar-maisuli, unnila gabmai.
Bela-dulemar-bukmalad Jesúsʼgi dodoarmalad, ar ade, wismalad we-bunolo burgwar mai.
Ar Jesúsʼdi, bunolo-argangi-gasgua, binnasur sogded: —Bunolo, be gwisgu.
Geb degi, bunolo-e-burba gannar ese nonigu, yog-gwisguar imaksad. Geb degi, Jesús sogded, bunologa masgunned ukmarye.
Bunolo-e-babgan deyob ibmar-gusadi geger dakarmalad. Jesúsʼdi sogded, mer dule-baiganga sogmaloye.
